text: We propose the Transformer, an encoder-decoder based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions.

evidence.quote: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

text: On WMT 2014 English-to-German the Transformer reaches 28.4 BLEU, more than 2 BLEU above the best previous results including ensembles.

evidence.quote: Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 Englishto-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU.
The Transformer achieves better BLEU scores than previous state-of-the-art models

text: We show that the Transformer generalizes to English constituency parsing with large and limited training data.

evidence.quote: We show that the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing both with large and limited training data.
